messages.subject: Re: How do I make radioButtons return the "choice name" and "label" or better all choices..
parts:
Make sure the choices you pass to radioButtons have named values, where the name is the label and the value is the value you want to get back. See the example under ?radioButtons. If you're getting back numbers instead of values, then perhaps you can show us the code in question?

Thanks.
